scenario: Visit a café with a friend: greet staff, order coffee, customize a drink, clear your cup, and request permission to charge a phone.

questions.normalizedText: greet the café staff politely say hello as you enter
order one cup of coffee ask for exactly one coffee not tea
order a hot coffee you do not want a cold drink or tea
ask for milk in your coffee add milk rather than sugar
ask where to put your empty cup you have finished your drink
ask if you may charge your phone request permission to use the café outlet
